result_text:
The region overview now lists open tickets high priority first, then normal, then low, and oldest first within each priority, the same order the sales-rep list uses. `RegionManagerTest` passes offline (`mvn -q -o`, no output, so no failures).

The change is one SQL `ORDER BY` in `listOpenSupportTicketsByRegion` in `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java` (around line 10021). It now sorts by `CASE t.priority WHEN 'HIGH' THEN 0 WHEN 'NORMAL' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, t.opened_date, t.id`, and I updated its Javadoc to match. The filters are unchanged, so closed tickets and other regions stay out.

Nothing in the existing tests checks this ordering, so the new order is not covered by a test. I did not add one, to keep the change small; say if you want a test for the T-1 to T-5 example.

I did not commit.
